name: Fake Game (SavePoint test)
notes: Disposable test fixture for tools/FakeGame: copy the built FakeGame executable into the install folder. Launch args are passed to the executable verbatim without {token} expansion, so --saves is a path relative to the install folder (where the game is started) that lands on external.path. On Linux and macOS the executable is FakeGame with no extension; the process name matches either way. To test the launcher-stub exit-detection path instead, put --spawn <path to the real game> and the game's own arguments after it in args.
